story.titleZh: 拉塞尔在巴库获DHL最快进站奖
story.summaryZh: F1官方X账号发帖称，拉塞尔在阿塞拜疆大奖赛迎来完美一天，梅赛德斯车队以2.33秒完成他的进站服务，斩获DHL巴库站最快进站奖。

An absolutely perfect day for @GeorgeRussell63, even in the pit lane 👌
Serviced in 2.33s by his @MercedesAMGF1 team, they earn the @DHL_Motorsports Fastest Pit Stop in Baku ⏱️
